title: Rafael and the Crown
author: Xanthe Ishikawa
blurb: Theo Pemberton, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
